head: a4f5ba566ab680b16969eaad321a0e48106f46ab

insert_or_assign_reverse_mutation.checked_in_test_error: libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::runtime_error: a prequantized output projection must not be replaced by the tied embedding
insert_or_assign_reverse_mutation.independent_test_error: libc++abi: terminating due to uncaught exception of type std::invalid_argument: [quantized_matmul] The weight matrix should be uint32 but received float32

should.finding: The regression checks projection dtype/values but does not execute Checkpoint::Linear/quantized_matmul with scales and biases; the missing-projection case checks dtype without asserting equality to the embedding.
should.impact: Production behavior passes the independent harness, but the checked-in test does not directly guard the reported runtime failure or the tied values.
should.suggested_test: Add a 64-wide mx::quantize fixture with weight/scales/biases and quantization config, run Checkpoint::Linear and compare with ordinary matmul; assert array_equal for the absent-projection fallback. The quantized-matmul check fails on the old insert_or_assign source with the original dtype error.

not_covered: No production checkpoint, real audio, recognition accuracy, or model inference was run; synthetic tensors exercised the exact loader and quantized linear code only.
No startup or first-Final performance ABABAB, physical-cold-disk measurement, production prequantized-cache generation, or cache invalidation was tested.
No Voxt App UI, interactive browser, permissions, microphone, or global-shortcut path was exercised because the PR has no App UI change.
